svg.aria-label: The layers of the code under internal, highest first; an import goes down, never up. cmd: the program, in WSL the launcher. front: what people use (cli, tui, api, ui, i18n). app: puts the rest together (app, demo). engine: a stop, a start and a check (distros, inside, stop, setup, check, history). settings: config. machine: wsl, winapi, gpo, eventlog. core: plain, version.
